message.content: An illustration for the cover of TEMPO magazine, dated 1-7 September 2014, features a central man with closed eyes, wearing a white, long-sleeved shirt. He is surrounded by numerous disembodied hands reaching toward him from all directions. Each hand holds a different fruit or vegetable, including a large orange pumpkin, a red dragon fruit, a bunch of yellow bananas, a green striped watermelon, a red tomato, a red apple, a large orange-and-green papaya, a brown round fruit, a dark purple eggplant, a red beet, an orange mango, an orange pear, a white tuber, and a green bitter melon. The man’s hands are held up in a gesture of refusal or hesitation. Large black text overlays his torso, reading "KETIKA HARUS MEMILIH." Other text at the top includes "UANG JUDI DI SAKU POLISI" and "CHATIB BASRI: HARGA BBM TAK PERLU NAIK SEKARANG." A red vertical bar appears on the left, and a barcode with "RP 35.000" is at the bottom left. The background is a muted, textured beige.
